module_summary: UART transmitter: a 4-state FSM (idle/start/data/stop) paced by a baud counter tick shifts a latched byte LSB-first onto tx_o, with valid/ready byte input.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: Idle/start/data/stop state register; drives tx_o mux, tx_ready, busy_o and counters.

anchors.name: shift_q
anchors.why: Shift register loaded with tx_data, shifted right each data-bit baud tick.

anchors.name: tx_valid
anchors.why: Byte-valid input; in idle it starts transmission and loads shift_q.

anchors.name: tx_ready
anchors.why: Ready output, high when FSM is idle.

anchors.name: tx_data
anchors.why: Parallel byte to transmit, latched into shift_q.

anchors.name: tx_o
anchors.why: Serial line output: start bit, shift_q[0] data bits, stop/idle high.

anchors.name: baud_cnt_q
anchors.why: Baud divider counter, cleared in idle or at terminal count CLK_DIV-1.

anchors.name: baud_tick
anchors.why: Baud-rate clock enable advancing FSM, shift register and bit index.

anchors.name: bit_idx_q
anchors.why: Counts transmitted data bits; at 7 ends DATA state.

anchors.name: busy_o
anchors.why: Level busy indication, high whenever FSM not idle.

groups.name: tx_controller
groups.description: Idle/start/data/stop FSM generating ready and busy indications.

groups.name: baud_timing
groups.description: Baud divider producing baud_tick and data-bit index counter.

groups.name: tx_serializer
groups.description: Loads tx_data on valid and shifts bits LSB-first onto tx_o.
